## Main manuscript tables: prior on ID70 and a

```{r}
# Generate operating-characteristic summaries for the rule-based and Bayesian CRM dose-finding designs
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load summary functions
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
source(here::here("fig_tables", "R", "rb_summary.R"))
source(here::here("fig_tables", "R", "bcrm_summary.R"))
source(here::here("fig_tables", "R", "get_sim_sum.R"))
source(here::here("fig_tables", "R", "tab_helpers.R"))
```


### Table 2
```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# User settings
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Select: "id70_p" or "ab_p"
prior_spec <- "id70_p"

# Select: "random" or "scenarios"
generation_method <- "random"

# Candidate dose grid
dose_grid <- 10^(3:7)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Obtain all four summaries
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
simulation_summaries <- get_all_simulation_summaries(
  generation_method = generation_method,
  prior_spec = prior_spec,
  dose_grid = dose_grid,
  cap_methods = c("uncapped", "capped")
)


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create the table
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
sample_size_table <- create_sample_size_tab(
  simulation_summaries
)

# Display the table
sample_size_table %>%
  kable(
    caption = paste(
      "Table 2. Summary of total sample sizes across 1,000 prior-predictive",
      "simulations for the rule-based and Bayesian CRM designs under",
      "uncapped and capped settings. Here, $N$ denotes the number of participants."
    ),
    col.names = c("Statistic", "Rule-based", "Bayesian CRM", "Rule-based","Bayesian CRM"),
    booktabs = TRUE,
    align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(
    c(
      " " = 1,
      "Panel A: Uncapped" = 2,
      "Panel B: Capped" = 2
    ),
    bold = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "19em") %>%
  column_spec(2:5, width = "10em") %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center",
    bootstrap_options = c(
      "striped",
      "hover",
      "condensed",
      "bordered"
    ),
    latex_options = c(
      "hold_position",
      "scale_down"
    )
  )
```

### Prior-implied skeleton
```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# User settings
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Prior distribution settings for a and log10(ID70)
# id70_p
# log(a) ~ Uniform(log(a_lower), log(a_upper))
# log10(ID70) ~ Normal(log10_id70_mean, log10_id70_sd^2),
# truncated to (log10_id70_lower, log10_id70_upper)

id70_settings <- list(
  a_lower = 0.3,
  a_upper = 0.8,
  log10_id70_mean = 4,
  log10_id70_sd = 0.8,
  log10_id70_lower = 3,
  log10_id70_upper = 7
)


# Distribution settings for a and b
# ab_p
# log(a) ~ Uniform(log(a_lower), log(a_upper))
# log(b) ~ Uniform(log(b_lower), log(b_upper))

ab_settings <- list(
  a_lower = 0.1,
  a_upper = 0.7,
  b_lower = 20,
  b_upper = 600
)

prior_skeleton_table <- summarise_prior_implied_skeleton(
  nsamp = 100000,
  id70_settings = id70_settings,
  ab_settings = ab_settings,
  candidate_doses = 10^(3:7),
  seed = 2025
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Format the prior-implied skeleton results
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

prior_skeleton_formatted <- prior_skeleton_table %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    dose_level = dose_level,
    
    challenge_dose = paste0(
      "$10^{",
      as.integer(log10(challenge_dose)),
      "}$"
    ),
    
    primary_median = sprintf(
      "%.3f",
      Primary_prior_median
    ),
    
    primary_cri = sprintf(
      "(%.3f, %.3f)",
      Primary_lower_95,
      Primary_upper_95
    ),
    
    alternative_median = sprintf(
      "%.3f",
      Alternative_prior_median
    ),
    
    alternative_cri = sprintf(
      "(%.3f, %.3f)",
      Alternative_lower_95,
      Alternative_upper_95
    )
  )

prior_skeleton_formatted %>%
  kable(
    caption = paste(
      "Prior-implied infection probabilities at the candidate challenge",
      "doses under the primary and alternative prior specifications."
    ),
    booktabs = TRUE,
    align = rep("c", 6),
    escape = FALSE,
    col.names = c(
      "Dose level",
      "Challenge dose (CFU)",
      "Prior median",
      "95% prior CrI",
      "Prior median",
      "95% prior CrI"
    )
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(
    c(
      " " = 2,
      "Primary prior: $(a, \\mathrm{ID}_{70})$" = 2,
      "Alternative prior: $(a,b)$" = 2
    ),
    bold = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "6em") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "10em") %>%
  column_spec(3:6, width = "9em") %>%
  footnote(
    general = paste(
      "Values are the prior median and pointwise 95% prior credible",
      "interval (CrI) for the infection probability at each candidate",
      "dose. The dose-specific prior medians form the descriptive",
      "prior-implied skeleton under each prior specification."
    ),
    general_title = "Note: ",
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center",
    bootstrap_options = c(
      "striped",
      "hover",
      "condensed",
      "bordered"
    ),
    latex_options = c(
      "hold_position",
      "scale_down"
    )
  )
```
